craft_notes: Sthāyin: Vismaya at unknowable workings, settling into plea. End-dash→comma (weighing softens into pause). Rejected: 'feast' for 'banquet' — L3 kept. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: Counted crores of charges, through fancy's flicker,
I pause, Bhava, and banquet deep in mind-joy of thee.
l4.sanskrit_cite: cintayitvāpi kartavyakoṭīś cittasya cāpalāt viśrāmyan bhava bhāvatkacittānande rame bhṛśam

reads_against.argmap: Having weighed even duty-crores, from mind's fickleness. → Resting from countless duties in your mind-bliss, I delight.
c1_essence: Pride claiming made-of-you yet not in self; rest in mind-bliss after weighing duties.

l2.plain_english: Pondered though crores of duties be, through mind's restlessness — I rest, O Bhava, and revel deeply in the bliss of mind in you.
